entries.title: I Chronicles 8:1
segments: ¶And Benjamin begot Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:2
segments: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:3
segments: And Bela had sons: Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:4
segments: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:5
segments: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:6
segments: --And these are the sons of Ehud (these were the chief fathers of the inhabitants of Geba; and they carried them away to Manahath;

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:7
segments: even Naaman, and Ahijah, and Gera; he removed them), and he begot Uzza and Ahihud.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:8
segments: And Shaharaim begot [children] in the land of Moab after he had sent away Hushim and Baara his wives.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:9
segments: And he begot of Hodesh his wife: Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:10
segments: and Jeuz, and Shobia, and Mirmah; these were his sons, chief fathers.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:11
segments: And of Hushim he begot Abitub, and Elpaal.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:12
segments: And the sons of Elpaal: Eber, and Misham, and Shemer, who built Ono, and Lod and its dependent villages;

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:13
segments: and Beriah, and Shema, who were chief fathers of the inhabitants of Ajalon; they drove away the inhabitants of Gath.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:14
segments: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:15
segments: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Eder,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:16
segments: and Michael, and Jishpah, and Joha were the sons of Beriah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:17
segments: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hiski, and Heber,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:18
segments: and Jishmerai, and Jizliah, and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:19
segments: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:20
segments: and Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:21
segments: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:22
segments: And Jishpah, and Eber, and Eliel,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:23
segments: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:24
segments: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:25
segments: and Jiphdeiah, and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:26
segments: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:27
segments: and Jaareshiah, and Elijah, and Zichri were the sons of Jeroham.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:28
segments: These were the chief fathers, according to their generations, principal men; these dwelt in Jerusalem.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:29
segments: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; and his wife's name was Maachah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:30
segments: And his son, the firstborn, was Abdon; and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:31
segments: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zecher.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:32
segments: And Mikloth begot Shimeah. And these also dwelt beside their brethren in Jerusalem, with their brethren.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:33
segments: ¶And Ner begot Kish; and Kish begot Saul; and Saul begot Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:34
segments: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-Baal; and Merib-Baal begot Micah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:35
segments: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:36
segments: And Ahaz begot Jehoaddah; and Jehoaddah begot Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begot Moza;

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:37
segments: and Moza begot Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:38
segments: And Azel had six sons, and these are their names: Azrikam, Bochru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan; all these were sons of Azel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:39
segments: And the sons of Eshek his brother were Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:40
segments: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers; and they had many sons, and sons' sons, a hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
